office_convert_guide_text:
PowerPoint conversion:
1. Auto Mode - Best Selection per Page
- Normal pages are converted to Editable Text / Images.
- Complex drawing/vector pages are handled as image slides preserving the original layout.
- This is the recommended default mode.

2. Image Slides Preserving Original Layout
- PDF pages are rendered as high-quality images and inserted into slides.
- The original appearance is preserved best, but text cannot be edited directly.

3. Editable Text / Images
- A full-page background image is not inserted.
- Images, text, and simple lines/rectangles inside the PDF are converted.
- Text overlap is avoided, but some complex layouts may be missing.

Word conversion:
- Extractable PDF text is saved as a Word document.

Excel conversion:
- PDF text is saved to Excel by page/line.
